description: Defines GraphQL object types for media fields, including MediaFieldQueryObjectType, MediaFileItemType, and the MediaFileItem data class, used for querying media-related data in OrchardCore.

classes.name: MediaFieldQueryObjectType
classes.description: GraphQL object type for querying MediaField data, including paths, file names, URLs, media texts, and files.

classes.name: MediaFileItemType
classes.description: GraphQL object type for individual media file items, exposing fileName, path, url, and mediaText fields.

classes.name: MediaFileItem
classes.description: Data class representing a media file item with properties for file name, path, URL, and media text.

methods.name: MediaFieldQueryObjectType
methods.description: Constructor setting up GraphQL fields for media data, with conditional legacy media fields support.

methods.name: MediaFileItemType
methods.description: Constructor defining GraphQL fields for MediaFileItem properties.
